text: Drone motor pitch and brightness follow speed and load, boost adds a whine, wind rises with speed, and the ambience bed shifts from city hum to open wind with altitude.
Positional ambience sits at verified real places, plays only in range and under its real conditions (fog, daylight, service hours), and costs zero nodes when far away.
Grace Cathedral rings Grace Chimes and strikes the real SF hour from 9 AM to 6 PM with the angelus at noon and 6 PM, and foghorns follow their Coast Guard patterns.
Generative lo-fi is deterministic per seed, follows day and night moods, lifts during activities and ducks under rewards.
Rings, discoveries, cards, completions, failures, crashes, splashes, menus, photos and toasts each play their own sound.
Audio stays light: a bounded node graph, bounded live voices, nothing for far sound spots, and a suspended context while muted or hidden.
The Sound panel mixes the four volumes, mutes, lists every sound spot with its live status and sets a waypoint to it.
